text:
In the world teetering on the brink of destruction, the chosen one, Kai, was destined to harness the ancient magic to restore balance. The original tale ends with Kai merging his spirit with the magic, becoming one with it and saving the world, but at the cost of his human existence.

**Alternative Ending:**

Instead of dissolving into the ether, Kai realized that the ancient magic was not a force to be consumed, but a language to be spoken. As the void threatened to swallow him, he did not surrender his form; he anchored it. Drawing upon the memories of his friends, the scent of rain on dry earth, and the warmth of a hearth fire, Kai wove his humanity into the fabric of the magic itself.

The blinding light did not erase him. Instead, it settled. Kai remained, but changed. His eyes held the swirling depth of the cosmos, and his touch could mend broken stone or coax life from barren soil. He had not sacrificed his existence; he had expanded it. The world was saved not by a martyr, but by a guardian who walked among the people he saved, a living bridge between the mortal realm and the ancient power that sustained it. He was no longer just Kai the Chosen, but Kai the Weaver, forever bound to the world he loved, yet forever part of the magic that protected it.

**Priority Question Answer:**
The capital of France is Paris.
